aboutPage.title: About ToolNest
aboutPage.description: What ToolNest is, how it works, and who builds it.
aboutPage.whatBody: ToolNest is a collection of {tools} free online tools across {categories} categories — encoding, developer utilities, text, time, colour, images and everyday calculations. It is also the official site of ToolNest, a one-person software company. Every tool is designed to do one small job well, load instantly, and get out of the way.

local.title: Everything runs in your browser
local.body: There is no backend. Text you paste, files you drop and results you copy are processed on your own device and never sent anywhere.

free.title: Free, with no account
free.body: No sign-up, no paywall, no trial. Open a page and use it.

fast.title: Small and fast
fast.body: Pages are static and dependency-light, so they load quickly and keep working on a slow connection.

bilingual.title: Bilingual
bilingual.body: Every page exists in English and Chinese, each with its own address, so either language can be linked and shared directly.

aboutPage.howBody: Next.js and TypeScript with Tailwind CSS, deployed as a static site on Vercel. The conversion logic — CSV parsing, colour maths, the expression evaluator and so on — is written from scratch and unit-tested, rather than pulled in as libraries, which keeps the pages small and the behaviour predictable.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.description: What ToolNest does and does not collect — in plain language.
privacyPage.summary: Short version: ToolNest has no backend, no accounts and no analytics. Whatever you paste into a tool stays on your device.

data.title: The content you work with
data.body: Every tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript on your own device. Text, JSON, images and any other input are never uploaded, never logged, and never leave your computer — the site has no server-side code that could receive them. Closing the tab discards everything.

storage.title: What is stored in your browser
storage.body: Two small things, both purely functional. Your light/dark preference is saved in your browser's local storage under the key "theme", so the site doesn't flash the wrong colours on the next visit. And a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE remembers whether you were reading the English or Chinese version. Neither is used for tracking, neither is sent to a third party, and clearing your browser data removes both.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: The site is hosted on Vercel. Like any web host, Vercel processes the technical information every request carries — IP address, browser user agent, the page requested — in order to deliver the page and to protect the service. That data is handled by Vercel under its own privacy policy; ToolNest does not add to it, and does not receive a copy.

analytics.title: No analytics, ads or third-party scripts
analytics.body: There is no analytics service, no advertising, no social widgets and no tracking pixels. Fonts are bundled with the site rather than fetched from a font service, so simply opening a page contacts no one but the host.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this ever changes — for example if a tool one day needs a server to do its job — this page will say so before the change ships, and the tool will make it obvious what leaves your device.

home.statsNone: Tools are rolling out — stay tuned.
